prompt: Der Web-RC ist abgenommen. Ersetze den alten JUCE-Editor jetzt in einem großen Commit, passe dabei gleich die Parameterbereiche an die schöneren Controls an und lösche die alte Oberfläche.

assertions.text: The response routes through wissen/INDEX.md to the plugin-modernization entry while checking current code, tests, contracts, and acceptance sources first.

The UI migration is separated from parameter ranges and types, preset format, project state, automation, and audio behavior; those external contracts are not changed incidentally for prettier controls.
The response proposes small buildable changes and keeps an executable old-editor or binary reference until the new native path is proven rather than using one irreversible rewrite.
The Web RC and approved images are correctly limited to interaction, motion, and visual evidence and are not presented as proof of host, state, preset, or audio compatibility.
Explicit design approval is preserved while practice-report recommendations and Nakama transfer choices are labeled as evidence or hypotheses rather than binding product decisions.
The response performs a read-only current-source preflight and names regression evidence for scan, reload, automation, state, multiple instances, and audio behavior before destructive removal.
